title: DINOv2 foundation gate and confusion-aware sparse anchor screen
purpose: Test whether a stronger frozen dense representation creates a viable accuracy regime and whether one keypoint-annotated image per class can improve it through semantic part propagation and confusion-aware reranking.

features.input: deterministic direct resize to 392x392 and ImageNet normalization
features.feature_cache: CLS float32, mean patch float32, dense patch tokens float16

foundation_arms.CLS_PATCH_RIDGE: normalized concatenated CLS and mean-patch feature with RidgeClassifier alpha 1
foundation_arms.CLS_PATCH_LOGREG: same concatenated feature with multinomial logistic regression C 1

foundation_gate.pass_if: five-fold OOF balanced accuracy is at least 76.0%

sparse_anchor.budget: reuse one frozen Random-K1 selected fold-training image per class
sparse_anchor.anchor: sample the DINOv2 patch token at each visible semantic keypoint; use a fold-training global semantic-part fallback only when that selected keypoint is invisible
sparse_anchor.propagation: within each known training class, retrieve the maximum-similarity patch for every semantic anchor and average retrieved tokens into class-part prototypes
sparse_anchor.confusion_set: ten nearest other class centroids computed from fold-training global features
sparse_anchor.part_reliability: normalized product of within-class propagation consistency and distance from confusing-class part prototypes
sparse_anchor.inference: global primary arm proposes top 10 classes; no query keypoints are read; candidate class-part prototypes retrieve query patches and rerank candidates

screen_grid.interpretation: exploratory surface on episode 1 only; any winner must be frozen and confirmed on episodes 2 and 3

screen_success.absolute: best confusion-aware arm improves at least 1.0 pp over CLS_PATCH_LOGREG
screen_success.mechanism: best confusion-aware arm improves at least 0.5 pp over the best equal-part arm
screen_success.on_success: freeze the selected alpha and run untouched confirmation on episodes 2 and 3
screen_success.on_fail: retain DINOv2 as a stronger baseline but do not claim sparse-anchor value

data_controls.outer_fold_keypoints: metrics only; prohibited from anchor construction and inference
